document.abstract: I hope 2012 brings you all many successes as our industry continues to grow, despite the tough economic times. As has become my tradition, I want to use this opportunity to share with you the many things we have planned for the coming New Year. You can read about the wonderful accomplishments of 2011 in President Peter Lude's column, which follows this one.
